patch_description: Use a “feature-to-entanglement-to-linear-readout” ansatz block with (1) per-qubit RY to break degeneracies from the fixed feature map, (2) fixed CZ brickwork to spread correlations quickly, (3) a small number of *shared-parameter* CRZ layers (3 parameters total, reused across many directed edges) to add controlled noncommuting phase interactions efficiently, and (4) a final per-qubit RZ to align the state so that measuring Z on all qubits becomes highly predictive after the fixed re-uploading schedule. This should improve accuracy and reduce the train-test gap while keeping parameter count moderate.
